grammar.title: Unless, Provided, As Long As
grammar.explanation:
English has more ways to talk about conditions than just **if**. **Unless** means *if not*: *I won't go **unless** you come too.*

**Provided (that)** and **as long as** mean *only if*. They set a strong condition: *You can borrow my car **as long as** you drive carefully.*

After **unless**, **provided** and **as long as**, use a positive verb and the present simple for the future. Don't add a negative after **unless** — it already means *if not*. Say *unless you hurry*, not *unless you don't hurry*.

**In case** is different: it means *because something might happen*. *Take an umbrella **in case** it rains.* You take it now, as a precaution.

**Even if** means *it doesn't matter whether*: *I'll go **even if** it rains.* **Suppose** and **what if** start imaginary situations: ***Suppose** you won the lottery, what would you do?*

An **assertive** speaker uses these words calmly and clearly. An **arrogant** attitude won't help — people listen when your conditions are fair.
examples: *I won't come **unless** you invite me.* (unless = if not)
*"**Unless** you hurry, you'll miss the bus."* (unless at the start)
*You can use my laptop **as long as** you're careful with it.* (only if)
*We'll go camping **provided** the weather is good.* (only if)
*Take some cash **in case** the shop doesn't accept cards.* (precaution)
*I'll finish this tonight **even if** I have to stay up late.* (it doesn't matter)

practice.q: Rewrite with unless: I won't forgive you if you don't apologise.
practice.a: I won't forgive you unless you apologise.

practice.q: Rewrite with as long as: You can join the club only if you follow the rules.
practice.a: You can join the club as long as you follow the rules.

practice.q: Rewrite with in case: Take your umbrella because it might rain later.
practice.a: Take your umbrella in case it rains later.

practice.q: Rewrite with provided: I'll lend you my notes only if you are assertive and ask for them.
practice.a: I'll lend you my notes provided you are assertive and ask for them.
